simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to טִבְחָה (H2878) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: טִבְחָה (ṭibchâh) means flesh, slaughter. First listed occurrence: 1Sam 25 11.

definitions.full: H2878. tibchah טִבְחָה noun feminine thing slaughtered, slaughtered meat, slaughter — l. suffix טִבְחָתִי as accusative of congnate meaning with verb after טָבַח 1Sam 25:11 of meat killed for food: 2 slaughter for food (= I. טֶבַח 1 ): ט ׳כְּצאֹן Psa 44:23 like a flock for slaughter , simile of the harassed godly; לְטִבְחָה כְּצאֹן Jer 12:3 simile of judgment of wicked (|| הֲרֵגָה לְיוֺם ).
definitions.rootNote: feminine of 2874 and meaning the same
